text:
Anna L: billing alert :rotating_light: saw a 4x GPU spend spike in us-west1 + us-central over the last 2 hours, seems autoscaler launched unreserved GPUs on-demand. anyone else seeing this?
Mark R: yup saw the same from cost-alerts. billing-bot flagged large on-demand p4d-like launches. Preliminary guess: fallback to unreserved pool due to selector/tag mismatch.
Sasha: digging into provisioner logs now. I see several Provisioner.accept calls with reason=selector_mismatch -> policy_override=true and then CreateNodeGroup fallback.
Sasha: snippet from the logs:
```
2026-03-18T08:12:04Z provisioner[0] INFO Accept: provisioner=ai-latency reason=selector_mismatch tags(expected)=reserved:team tags(actual)=team=ml override=true
2026-03-18T08:12:05Z autoscaler[0] INFO Launching: instance_type=n2-p4d-8 count=12 pool=on-demand-region-us-central1
```
Kai: we rotated a terraform var yesterday that renamed the reservation tag from `reserved:team` -> `gpu:team` in the reserved pools. autoscaler policy config still expects the old key so the selector no longer matched. PR #678 did the rename.
Anna L: estimated impact from billing preview ~ $24k over 3.5 hours :chart_with_upwards_trend:. I opened INC-3412 for finance + support. link: https://internal/INC-3412
Mark R: short term mitigation: we should prevent any more fallback launches. I'm going to flip autoscaler.fallback=false and cordon new unreserved nodes.
Sasha: running cordon/drain on the unreserved nodes now and adding a nodeSelector that requires `reserved:team` for the reserved pool.
Sasha: commands I'm running:
```
kubectl get nodes -l cloudpool=on-demand -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
kubectl label node <node> reserved=false
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
infra-bot: deploybot: rolled back autoscaler policy commit 590e -> 589d (by Mark R).
Kai: I'm also reverting the terraform var rename and will push a hotfix to align the pool tags with the reserved commitment. Adding a CI check to compare reserved pool tags vs terraform vars.
billing-bot: Billing alert acknowledged. Opened cloud ticket case 555123 with provider to dispute mis-provisioned hours.
Anna L: good. we need a postmortem and a cost breakdown for finance. Mark, can you own the postmortem? ETA EOD?
Mark R: yes, will draft postmortem and include timeline, graphs from cost explorer, and the terraform diff. I'll add a remediation ticket to CI to block tag renames without a migration plan.
Sasha: also adding a runtime guard: if selector mismatch occurs >3 times in 15m, set autoscaler.fallback=false and create an alert in PagerDuty.
Kai: confirmed revert pushed, infra tests green.
Anna L: thanks everyone — keep updates in INC-3412 thread. we'll reconcile final numbers with finance once cloud confirms the hours. :thumbsup:
Mark R: follow-up actions -> 1) postmortem 2) CI guard 3) enforce-reservation flag 4) billing dispute. I'll update INC-3412 as I make progress.
billing-bot: Billing ticket updated: case 555123 -> assigned to provider team. Tentative refund request submitted.
